entities.name: Martinho da Costa Lopes

entities.summary: Martinho da Costa Lopes was an East Timorese religious and political leader. He was a priest of the Catholic Church, the highest-ranking official of the Church in East Timor from 1977 to 1983, and a member of the National Assembly in Lisbon.
